your_book:
Tuesday was a broadly constructive day for Jaleel's book, though the headline gain masks a meaningful split under the hood. The software sleeve led on the upside — NOW and ADBE each surged roughly 4.8%, adding real dollar weight to a portfolio where they collectively represent over 22% — yet both moves came against a backdrop of fresh OpenAI competitive noise (the reported "Presence" product targeting enterprise back-office automation). That's worth sitting with: the market bought both names today, but the thesis risk flagged on ADBE — AI disruption eroding the moat — just got a new data point. The rally may be noise-driven short covering rather than conviction. ABT continued to earn its keep, up 2.66% and sitting on a 24% open gain at $2,574 — the book's clearest quality-and-performance combination right now. GILD, NVS, NBIX, VRTX, and KO all ticked higher in a quiet but tidy defensive sweep.

The drag that demands attention is RKLB, down another 4.56% today, now sitting on an -18.5% open loss at $3,194 — the largest single position in the book at 14% weight, rated AVOID with a QARP of just 46.5. Price and thesis are moving in the same direction, and that direction is wrong. SPGI also slipped 3.52% despite broader financial-sector tailwinds from easing rate expectations, an odd divergence that warrants a look. BSX reports tomorrow (July 29) already carrying an elevated risk flag after its FY26 growth guidance was slashed to 7–8.5% — that's the most time-sensitive event on the calendar.

Overall book value sits at $22,819 with unrealized gains of $292 (+1.34%), cash at $802. The account is in fine shape on the surface, but RKLB's size, verdict, and continued deterioration is the structural issue that keeps surfacing. A capital-preservation mandate and a 14% AVOID-rated position are in direct tension.

attention.headline: Largest position, AVOID-rated, down 18.5% — no thesis support
attention.note: At 14% of the book, RKLB is the single biggest weight, carries an AVOID verdict and a QARP of 46.5, and fell another 4.56% today — this combination is flatly inconsistent with a capital-preservation mandate and demands a sizing or exit decision.

attention.note: BSX reports in less than 24 hours carrying an elevated risk flag — FY26 growth cut to 7–8.5% and management guiding flat through Q3 — making tomorrow a binary event for a position already down 3.8%.

attention.headline: Up 4.81% today, but OpenAI 'Presence' directly targets its moat
attention.note: Today's rally in ADBE came on the same day that new competitive headlines (OpenAI's enterprise automation push) reinforced the exact AI-disruption thesis already flagged as a risk — price moved up while the threat moved closer, a divergence worth monitoring closely.
